articles.title: Unilever-McCormick Deal Facing In Depth Review From UK Watchdog
articles.summary: Unilever Plc and spice maker McCormick & Co.’s $44.8 billion deal faces an in depth investigation unless the firms offer remedies to allay the watchdog’s competition concerns.

articles.title: Dubai’s DIP Rises as Much as 6% in UAE’s First IPO Since War
articles.summary: Dubai’s DIP Holding Plc shares rose after the company’s $529 million initial public offering, an indicator of investor appetite for the first listing from the United Arab Emirates this year.

articles.title: Luxury Watch Platform Subdial Raises $20 Million for Its US Push
articles.summary: Luxury watch-trading platform Subdial is raising $20 million to accelerate its US expansion as it bets on growing demand in the world’s largest secondary market for timepieces, according to people familiar with the matter.

articles.title: Japan Government Bond Yields Jump, Tracking Treasury Selloff
articles.summary: Japanese government bonds fell on Wednesday, tracking an overnight selloff in Treasuries after hotter-than-expected US inflation fueled bets that the Federal Reserve may need to raise interest rates more aggressively.
